newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline barges up $1 as sep swaps gain $4.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline barges up $1 as sep swaps gain $4.

text.p: NWE gasoline barges gained $1 on Tuesday in a thinly traded physical market, although a more busy swaps market saw levels rise by $4-$4.50 on September.

The September swaps gains to $201-$202, linked by dealers to a resurgence in crude futures values, were underlined by trades at $200 and $201, with the seller of the $200 swap seen buying a November at $186 in a connected deal.

A single barge trade was earlier rumoured at $227. AR bids were later heard at $225 and Rotterdam running refinery at $226, with the latter offered at $228 as ARA volumes were heard offered by an Antwerp refiner at $226.

MTBE values were believed broadly unchanged at $313-$315 in the wake of a late August sale at $314 FPB Rotterdam of 1,000 tonnes of MTBE by a leading trans-Atlantic producer to a Scandinavian oil company.
